items.title: Play Age Signals API data use restriction
items.applies_to: Google Play apps that call the Play Age Signals API.
items.action: Use Age Signals data only to provide age-appropriate experiences in the app that received it.
items.evidence: Starting on January 1, 2026, to help protect users' data, developers may only use data provided by the Age Signals API to provide age-appropriate experiences

items.title: Texas App Store Accountability Act statutory effective date
items.applies_to: App stores and developers with users located in Texas.
items.action: Use store-provided age category and parental consent signals and follow the developer duties in the Act.
items.evidence: SECTION 3. This Act takes effect January 1, 2026.

items.title: Play US external content links and alternative billing compliance
items.applies_to: Google Play apps that link US users to external content or offer alternative billing systems.
items.action: Enroll in and comply with the external content links and alternative billing program requirements.

items.title: Apple updated age rating questionnaire responses due

items.title: Apple blocks 18+ app downloads for unconfirmed adults
items.applies_to: Apps rated 18+ on the App Store in Australia, Brazil and Singapore.
items.action: Expect downloads to be limited to confirmed adults and check any separate duty to confirm user age, for example with the Declared Age Range API.
items.evidence: Starting February 24, 2026, Apple will block users in Australia, Brazil, and Singapore from downloading apps rated 18+

items.date_note: applied immediately to new apps from 2026-01-28

items.evidence: existing apps will have until March 4, 2026 to come into compliance

items.evidence: By March 17, 2026, all current members of the Apple Developer Program will need to agree to the latest update

items.title: watchOS uploads must include 64-bit support

items.action: Build with the watchOS 26 SDK and include 64-bit (arm64) support.
items.evidence: Beginning April 2026, watchOS apps uploaded to App Store Connect must also include 64-bit support and be built with the watchOS 26 SDK.

items.title: COPPA Rule amendments compliance date

items.action: Complete the news self-declaration in Play Console, otherwise the app is removed.
items.evidence: All news and magazine apps are reminded to complete the self-declaration in Play Console by May 27, 2026.

items.title: Play prediction market pilot enrollment deadline

items.title: Apple applies Texas SB 2420 age assurance requirements

items.action: Use the Declared Age Range API, the PermissionKit Significant Change API and the consent revocation server notification as the law requires.
items.evidence: These changes will go into effect starting June 4, 2026.

items.title: App Store age ratings change in Australia and Vietnam
items.applies_to: Apps on the App Store in Australia (15+ rating removed) and Vietnam (region-specific rating required).

items.title: Accept updated Apple license agreement with Brazil terms

items.title: Play child safety rules extend to anonymous chat apps
items.applies_to: Anonymous chat and random chat apps on Google Play.
items.action: Meet the Child Safety Standards and Age-Restricted Content and Functionality requirements and do not target children.
items.evidence: 2026-08-26 Child Endangerment We're expanding our Child Safety Standards policy to apply to anonymous chat and random chat apps.

items.title: Play existing apps must target API 35
items.applies_to: Existing apps on Google Play that are not being updated.
items.action: Update the app to target Android 15 (API 35) or higher to stay available to users on newer Android versions.
items.evidence: existing apps (across mobile and Android Auto) must target Android 15 (API level 35) or higher by August 31, 2026

items.date_note: extension available until 2026-11-01; Wear OS and Android Automotive OS need API 35, other form factors have their own levels on the source page
items.title: Play new apps and updates must target API 36
items.applies_to: New apps and app updates submitted to Google Play.
items.action: Set targetSdkVersion to 36 (Android 16) or higher, or request the extension in Play Console.
items.evidence: Starting August 31, 2026: New apps and app updates must target Android 16 (API level 36) or higher to be submitted to Google Play

items.title: Apple social media age rating questions become required
items.applies_to: New apps and updates submitted to the App Store or for notarization for alternative distribution.
items.action: Answer the social media capability questions in the App Store Connect age rating questionnaire.
items.evidence: beginning in September 2026, responses will be required when submitting new apps or updates to the App Store

items.title: iOS and iPadOS uploads must target iOS 13 or later
items.applies_to: iOS and iPadOS apps uploaded to App Store Connect.
items.action: Set the minimum deployment target to iOS 13 or later before uploading.
items.evidence: Since September 9, 2026 iOS and iPadOS apps uploaded to App Store Connect must target iOS 13 or later.

items.title: New single Apple business terms for EU apps
items.applies_to: Every developer distributing apps in the European Union on the App Store or through alternative distribution.
items.action: Review and accept the updated license agreement (Attachment 14) and plan for the new commission structure.
items.evidence: These terms will go into effect on October 1, 2026.

items.title: Two content descriptors move to 12+ in Korea
items.applies_to: Games and Entertainment apps distributed on the App Store in the Republic of Korea.
items.action: Review questionnaire answers because infrequent profanity or crude humor and infrequent mature or suggestive themes now rate 12+ in Korea.
items.evidence: starting in October 2026, two content descriptors will move from an age rating of All to 12+ for the App Store in Korea

items.title: Shared Location and Dating declarations due for all apps
items.applies_to: Every app on the App Store.

items.title: Play Contacts Permissions policy takes effect
items.applies_to: Google Play apps that request broad access to user contacts.
items.action: Use the Android Contact Picker unless broad contacts access is needed for core functionality.
items.evidence: 2027-01-27 Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information We're introducing the Contacts Permissions policy to govern broad access of users' contacts.

items.title: Play updated Location Permissions policy becomes mandatory
items.applies_to: Google Play apps that request location, in particular precise location on apps targeting Android 17 (API 37) or higher.
items.action: Use the minimum location scope, adopt the location button for one-time requests and declare ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION use in Play Console.
items.evidence: this policy was announced last April and will become mandatory on January 27, 2027

items.title: READ_CALL_LOG no longer allowed for account verification
items.applies_to: Google Play apps that use READ_CALL_LOG to verify accounts by phone call.
items.action: Switch to an alternative such as the Digital Credentials API or the SMS Retriever API.
items.evidence: on January 27, 2027, account verification via phone call will no longer be a permitted use case for the READ_CALL_LOG permission

items.title: Play updates must support 16 KB page sizes
items.applies_to: App updates on Google Play that target Android 15 (API 35) or higher and include native code.
items.action: Rebuild native libraries with 16 KB ELF alignment and package with AGP 8.5.1 or higher.
items.evidence: Starting February 1, 2027, if your app updates don't support 16 KB memory page sizes, you won't be able to release these updates.
